entities.name: Zetalpa
entities.description: Elder dinosaur of Ixalan, a giant pteranodon embodying white mana and the sun.

entities.name: Orazca
entities.description: Golden city whose hibernation held the elder dinosaurs in stasis.

entities.name: Etali
entities.description: Elder dinosaur compleated by Phyrexia, who battled Zetalpa.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Phyrexian invasion during which Zetalpa fought Etali.
